family_stats.name: ci-log
family_stats.description: Jest CI run: hundreds of PASS lines, one FAIL block, a flaky-retry near-miss, coverage table tail.

family_stats.name: py-traceback
family_stats.description: Worker log with one fatal Python traceback (deep library frames) and one handled near-miss traceback.

family_stats.name: tsc-errors
family_stats.description: Build output dominated by warnings from the same file; exactly one hard error (TS2345).

family_stats.name: grep-def
family_stats.description: ripgrep output where every line mentions the symbol; only one is the definition. Mock with a prefix-sharing name is the near miss.

family_stats.name: find-paths
family_stats.description: `find` listing of an infra repo. Gold path has env/region/resource siblings that differ in one segment.

family_stats.name: service-logs
family_stats.description: Interleaved multi-service access/app logs. One ERROR with request id; WARN retries carry adjacent ids.

family_stats.name: multi-hop
family_stats.description: Two-hop: the error line names a session id; a separate auth line maps that session to a user. Both are needed.

family_stats.name: aggregate-fails
family_stats.description: Global question: list EVERY failing test. 4-9 failures scattered through a pytest -v run; all must survive.

family_stats.name: git-diff
family_stats.description: Multi-file unified diff. Gold is a -/+ pair in one hunk; other hunks change similar config keys.

family_stats.name: json-records
family_stats.description: Pretty-printed JSON API response (one field per line). Answer needs the id line and sibling fields of the same object.

family_stats.name: sql-table
family_stats.description: psql aligned table output. Gold row must survive; header row needed to interpret it. Ids differ by digit transposition.

family_stats.name: code-file
family_stats.description: Source file read. Gold constant lives inside the current function; a *Legacy twin holds a different value.

family_stats.name: docs-rag
family_stats.description: Markdown product docs (RAG chunk dump). Paraphrase queries share almost no words with the gold sentence.

family_stats.name: chat-transcript
family_stats.description: Long agent/user transcript. A decision is made once; a rejected alternative appears later.
